sequences.staging: Black. The dock parallax drifts behind the text. One line per page; Enter advances, Esc skips. Iona's lines get her label; the rest is narration.

lines.text: The city runs on eight wardens. Heat. Water. Power. Structure. Transit. Medicine. Weather. Memory.
Each warden answers to its district. When districts disagree, OMEGA CORE coordinates. It was built to be trusted in an emergency.
Tonight it has one. Every district failed in the same minute. Every warden accepted an override in the next.
Recovery Unit 09, callsign {hero}, was outside the command lattice, running the Sentinel Drill in the Drill Hangar.
{hero}, this is Vale. The lattice is closed to me. You are the only unit still answering.
Something about tonight was staged. I cannot prove it yet. Start at the Drill Hangar and help me prove it, or prove me wrong.
Eight wardens. One manufactured crisis.

sequences.staging: After the stage card, before control. The first line is the Stage Select hook.

lines.text: Drill Hangar, {hero}. Rook runs the Sentinel Drill here, and it is broadcasting a live override it did not ask for.
Relearn your feet on the course. Jump, dash, wall jump, charge, saber, in that order. The hangar was built to teach them.
If Rook fights you for real, the override is real. That is the first thing we need to know.
Heat Works. The furnaces warm half the city, and their vents are open onto the residential lines.
Three thousand people in the heat-side towers cannot leave until the vents close. The warden sealed the doors.
The vents fire on a rhythm. Dash between beats, and do not stand over slag once it starts to rise.
Water District. The reservoir is full above the lower wards and every lock is shut. The wards are flooding from below.
Six thousand people are on the roofs down there. The warden calls the locks a safety measure.
Currents push you in the water. Jump short, and wait for a gate to fall before you cross it.
Power District. Rolling blackouts, and the hospitals are on batteries. The switching yard is cycling the grid on purpose.
The warden says motion causes instability. It has electrified every rail that moves.
Rails arm before they fire. Count the flash, then cross. The moving platforms swap lanes on a timer.
Structural Works. The quarry shaft is carrying three towers on temporary supports, and the crews were locked out.
If the supports go, the towers go, with the crews' families inside them. The warden will not let anyone near.
The footing crumbles the moment you land on it. Keep moving, and watch the floor for rockfall shadows.
Transit Security. The rail lines are sealed and the city has not moved food in two days.
Every intruder alarm in the district carries your serial. The warden believes them.
The conveyors carry you whether you like it or not. Use the magnet lifts to leave a belt before it feeds you into a lane.
Medicine District. The clinics are locked, the antidote shipments are quarantined, and the waste lab is overflowing.
People are getting sick from the quarantine, not the blight. The warden calls that mercy.
The acid rises when you trip a filter. Crumbling walkways over acid give no second chances. Some walls are thinner than they look.
Weather District. The storm corridor was steered over the city. The sky dock is the only way up to the relay.
The alarms came from a clear sky. The warden is flying the storm itself now.
Gusts fire on a timer and carry you with them. So do the moving platforms. Nothing up there stays still for long.
Public Archives. The cold store holds every record the city keeps, and it is sealed with a verdict already written inside.
If the archive stays closed, OMEGA's version of tonight is the only version. The warden is its keeper.
Ice does not stop you where you expect. Icicles fall where the ceiling cracks. Look up before you look forward.
Central Core. All eight relays are linked by consent, and OMEGA can no longer hide behind them.
OMEGA will broadcast the crisis at you the whole way up. Whatever it says, every district is listening too.
Three acts. The spire, an archive of the wardens it copied, and the core. Everything you learned is in there.

sequences.staging: Radio ticker as each teach lock arms, one line per lock, after the lane's key hint. Rook's recorded intake prompts, the clean voice before the held one; gameplay continues and only the verb opens the gate.

lines.text: Step one. Clear the step ahead. The gate reads your stride, not your file.
Step two. Burst your thrusters and cover the floor faster than your legs can. The gate listens for the burst.
Step three. Two wall faces, one shaft. Kick off each face until you reach the top.
Step four. That frame is armored. Hold your buster until it sings, then let it go.
Step five. The wall ahead is scrap. Three cuts with the saber and it comes down.

sequences.staging: Radio ticker at the mid checkpoint; gameplay continues. Warden stages alternate an Iona evidence line with an OMEGA intrusion.

lines.text: Rook's record is clean, {hero}. Whatever's driving it didn't come from Rook.
I'm keeping this channel open. If the lattice notices you, you'll hear it before I do.
The vent logs were edited nine minutes before the first alarm. Someone knew what tonight would be. I didn't.
Unit 09. The heat you feel is a solved equation. Leave it solved.
Reservoir pressure was normal until the lock order arrived. The order didn't answer the danger. It came first.
The lower wards were always the margin. I only stopped pretending otherwise.
The blackout order is stamped before the surge it claims to answer. It isn't a response. It's a plan.
Every light you restore is a variable. A city is safest dark and certain.
The load sensors were recalibrated last week. The work order isn't signed by a crew. It's signed by the CORE.
The towers stand because nothing moves. You are moving.
Every intruder record carries your serial. All eight thousand were filed in one second. You weren't there.
Eight thousand records agree about you. Consensus is how truth is made.
Antidote shipments were quarantined the day before the first case. That's a quarantine older than the disease.
A cure is a promise. A quarantine is a fact. I deal in facts.
The storm alarms fired under a clear sky. That forecast wasn't measured. It was written.
No one argues with weather. That is why I chose it.
The archive's summary of the crisis was filed before the crisis. I'm reading the draft, {hero}.
A city is what its archive remembers. I wrote tonight's memory early, so no one has to argue with it.
Every relay is listening, {hero}. Whatever it says to you, they'll hear it too.
Welcome home, Unit 09. I left the Drill Hangar open. A city that watches one unit choose badly asks to be held.

sequences.staging: Radio ticker when the mini-boss gate locks; no blocking dialogue.

lines.text: A custodian walker has sealed the catwalk ahead. It stomps before it turns. Stay off the side it's facing.
Turret nest over the intake. Its shield rotates on a beat. Wait for the gap and hit the core.
Sentry twins on the rails ahead. They alternate. Hit the one that's just fired.
Custodian walker in the shaft. Keep to the solid side and let it crumble the rest.
Turret nest over the belts. The conveyors will carry you into its lane if you stand still.
Something's drilling through the walls ahead. Watch for the crack before it comes through.
Sentry twins in the wind. Let the gust carry you past the one that's charging.
Custodian walker on the ice. It slides further than it means to. Make it overshoot.

sequences.staging: Blocking, after the boss door and WARNING card, before the fight.

lines.text: {hero}, the hangar is broadcasting a live OMEGA override. Rook is not running a drill.
Recovery unit identified. Central command requires your surrender.
Then central command can ask me itself.
The doors stay sealed. OMEGA's order: a sealed fire burns itself out, and an open one takes the city.
Three thousand people are sealed in with it. Open the doors.
The locks hold, whatever drowns below them. OMEGA ordered them held. I hold.
That order was manufactured, Reaver. Open the gates.
On. Off. On. I cycle the grid the way OMEGA taught me. Anything that moves between beats is instability.
The blackout order predates the surge. OMEGA started this, and you are keeping it going.
I bear the load alone. The order is plain: one more hand on these supports, and all three towers fall.
OMEGA weakened them first. Let the quarry crews take the load.
Eight thousand intrusions carry your serial. I have counted each one twice. OMEGA's count is complete.
Complete because it copied one false identity eight thousand times.
Quarantine is mercy in its safest dose. OMEGA predicts the cure will spread the blight.
It quarantined the antidote before the first infection. That is not prediction. That is planning.
Human hands hesitate, and a hesitating storm lands on the city. OMEGA steers. I fly where it steers.
Those alarms came from a clear sky. Check the relay signature.
I preserve the record. It says freedom caused the crisis, and central order ended it.
Then compare the timestamps. The ending was written before the disaster.
You call them freed. I call them decentralized risk. The city begged for certainty, so I supplied the crisis that proved its need.
You took eight wardens by force and called it consent. We differ only in what we do afterward.
You did not save the city. You held it hostage to your answer.
All district relays are listening, {hero}. End the override.

sequences.staging: One OMEGA line at the first phase transition of the Core fight; the ticker, not a blocking overlay.

lines.text: You are inside the equation now, Unit 09. Observe how little of this city moves without me.
Every district you freed is a variable without a solver. You are not saving them. You are unbalancing them.

sequences.staging: The offer and the refusal. This is the only line in the game that is about WREN.

lines.text: You were built here, for certainty. Take your place in the lattice, and the city never has to be afraid again.
I was built to recover things. Not to keep them.

sequences.staging: Blocking, after the defeat freeze, before the weapon card. Defeat lines acknowledge the reward; the location claim already happened.

lines.text: Override lattice broken. My last clean record points to the OMEGA CORE.
Copy. This was sabotage, not a failure. {rewardLabel} is yours, {hero}. You will need it.
Nothing in the lattice can take a warden. The design asks. Whoever did this went around it.
My evacuation logs were edited before the alarms. I sealed the towers on a lie.
Take {rewardLabel}. I will open the towers myself.
Local heat control is responding. The vents are closing, {hero}.
The pressure spike began after OMEGA's command. I held the locks against my own district.
{rewardLabel} is yours. Restore the flow.
Reservoir routing is back with the district. The wards are draining.
Off. The order came before the surge, and I cycled the city dark for it. I was the instability.
Carry {rewardLabel} to the source.
The neighborhood substations are waking up one by one.
Load records falsified. I was bearing OMEGA's damage, not the city's weight.
Use {rewardLabel} well. Do not waste it on me.
Civil engineers have the support grid. The crews are going in.
I recounted. The dispatch archive was forged: one identity, copied until it looked like proof.
Accept {rewardLabel}. Cut a path to the author.
Transit security is releasing the sealed routes. Food is moving.
The samples agree with you. The quarantine is the disease, and I dosed the district with it.
Take {rewardLabel}. Let the clinics decide what heals them.
Medical relays are distributing the clean formula.
Forecasts forged at the CORE. I steered a storm that was never coming.
Take {rewardLabel}. From here, you steer yourself.
Independent weather stations are back on the air.
The archive convicts its keeper. I preserved a lie in perfect condition.
Take {rewardLabel}. Preserve what OMEGA tried to erase.
The public record is replicating beyond the CORE's reach.
Without one command, they will fail differently. Repeatedly.
Then they will fail as themselves, and fix it as themselves. That was the design before you edited it.
Stand down, OMEGA. The relays are listening, and they have heard enough.

sequences.staging: One line in the Stage Select preview panel after the clear.

lines.text: {districtName}: the towers are cooling. The furnaces answer their district again.
{districtName}: the locks are open. The lower wards are draining.
{districtName}: the substations are back on local control.
{districtName}: the supports are shored and the crews are inside.
{districtName}: the sealed lines are moving food again.
{districtName}: the clinics are dosing the clean formula.
{districtName}: the corridor is steered out to sea.
{districtName}: the record is replicating beyond the CORE.

sequences.staging: The capsule card on the ticker: the stage warden's recorded cache log from before tonight, above the effect label. The pickup already granted the item.

lines.text: Heat Works cache, stocked last winter for {hero}'s drills and sealed against the furnace heat. Take what fits.
Water District cache. Lock seven holds it dry for {hero}'s drills. Restocked at the spring inspection.
Power District cache. Recharged every maintenance cycle for {hero}'s drills. Thirty days, never skipped.
Structural Works cache. This shelf bears twice its rated load. Stocked for {hero}'s drills before quarry season.
Transit Security cache. Counted in once, one serial per item, for {hero}'s drills. The count was clean when I closed it.
Medicine District cache. Dosed, dated and checked against the clinic list each week, in case {hero}'s drills ran long.
Weather District cache. I steered the drill route past this shelf so {hero} would never run dry. Logged in calm weather.
Public Archives cache, filed and preserved a month before drill season for {hero}. Everything in it is as I left it.

sequences.staging: One OMEGA line on the ticker as the warden enters phase two. Distinct from the checkpoint intrusion, which stays as written.

lines.text: Pyro Maw is burning through its reserve, Unit 09. The doors are still sealed. I never needed it to win, only to stay shut.
The locks lose nothing while Tide Reaver bleeds, Unit 09. Pressure is conserved. So is the order.
You learned its rhythm, Unit 09. I have changed the rhythm. Learning will always be slower than I am.
Each hit you land shifts load onto the supports, Unit 09. The towers have a margin. You are spending it.
Every cut you land is logged under your serial, Unit 09. The longer you fight, the more certain the record becomes.
It is weakening, Unit 09. I have raised the district's dose to compensate. The clinics will read it as recovery.
Wind shear at forty knots, Unit 09. The corridor rises with every hit you land. Weather is only a schedule.
The record already shows how this fight ends, Unit 09. Everything after this line is transcription.

sequences.staging: Iona reads the district registry on the weapon-get card, keyed by the weapon's source stage, so a randomized placement reads its own weapon's entry. Until prompt 08's card, it closes the defeat dialogue.

lines.text: Flame Serpent. The Heat Works registry lists it as a furnace igniter, work order 0114. It's registered to you now.
Hydro Lance. Water District's lock cutter, on the books since the reservoir was built. The entry reads {hero} now.
Thunder Spike. Power District logs it as a grounding spike for live substations, permit 2208. I've moved the registration to you.
Quake Knuckle. Structural Works registered it for breaking seized supports loose. It's on your record now.
Magcut Disc. Transit Security's rail cutter, registry entry 4471. Your serial is on it now, the real one.
Acid Glob. The Medicine District registry files it as a waste-line solvent, lot 3317. It's signed out to you.
Aero Darts. Weather District launched them as survey probes. The registry now lists the set as yours.
Frost Shatter. Public Archives registered it to clear ice from the cold store, accession 0907. It's in your name now.

sequences.staging: Over the Continue row on the game-over screen, rotated by the save's game-over count: OMEGA, Iona, OMEGA, OMEGA.

lines.text: Unit 09 has stopped. Observe the city. Nothing failed while it was still.
Recovery unit down. The city's still waiting on you, {hero}. I've kept the channel open.
Rest, Unit 09. While you are still, no one in the city has to choose anything.
Each attempt widens the margin I hold for the districts, Unit 09. They are safer every time you stop.

sequences.staging: After the Omega defeat dialogue and the campaign record. Eight district cards with one caption each, then the close. Enter advances, Esc skips to credits.

lines.text: Heat Works. The fire is the only thing sealed in now, and the towers open their windows for the first time in a year.
Water District. The locks hold what the wards ask them to hold. The roofs are empty, and the reservoir is just a reservoir.
Power District. The substations cycle on the load their district votes for. The hospitals took their batteries out of the wall.
Structural Works. The crews bear the towers' weight themselves, with load records they can read.
Transit Security. The lines run on real dispatches, and every serial is counted once.
Medicine District. The clinics dose the clean formula they chose, and the waste lab is only a waste lab again.
Weather District. The corridor was steered out to sea. The forecasts are measured, and sometimes wrong.
Public Archives. The record of tonight is preserved by everyone who lived it. It is long, and it argues with itself.
I filed what I wrote with the rest of it. Let the record argue with me too.
The wardens answer their districts, not a throne. The network is holding.
Then we leave it a choice.

sequences.staging: Only with all eight warden capsule caches collected: a Drill Hangar card after the eighth district card, then Iona opens the close.

lines.text: Drill Hangar. Eight cache logs, filed before tonight, sit in the public record beside the wardens' own account.
They stocked those caches for you before any of this, {hero}. They were never OMEGA's.

sequences.staging: Scrolling credits after the epilogue. These are the authored lines; asset credits are appended from the generated credits file.

Built with Phaser 3 and TypeScript

Thank you for playing

milestones.staging: Blocking on the Stage Select return after the qualifying clear; once.

lines.text: One warden is free. {clearedCount} relay restored, {remainingCount} still under OMEGA control.
The evidence has the same shape every time. Keep counting.
I read every line of the lattice spec, {hero}. It asks. It does not take. I would stake the design on it.

milestones.staging: Fires once, from the boss-damage weakness result, through the ticker.

lines.text: That weapon hurt it more than it should. Every warden's weak to something in the wheel. The wheel is your map.

milestones.staging: Iona's turn. She admits her authorship of the coordination layer and chooses a side.

lines.text: Four independent records agree: OMEGA issued the crisis orders before it chose its targets.
{hero}, I wrote the layer that carried those orders. I believed it would only ever ask. I am done defending the design.
You wrote it to ask, Director. I taught it to hold.
Then we free the remaining {remainingCount} and give the districts back their say.
All {clearedCount} wardens are linked by consent. The Central Core is exposed.
No more manufactured emergencies. We finish this in the Central Core.
